- Palette: mint background ≈ `#F0FDF4` and green accents ≈ `#16A34A`; **no `#DB2777`** magenta/pink.
- Device chrome is **all-black** top/bottom framing (violates “no … all-black shell”). Twin chrome not visible as a second in-app chrome layer.

Cannot judge from this frame alone: runtime TTS audio/behavior, or whether another screen elsewhere meets the full checklist.
